claims.evidence: Remote inspection cannot confirm internal hardware functionality or software stability.
Photo 0 shows a slim black game console identified as a PS4.
Photo 0 shows two black wireless controllers.

claims.claim: fifa 24, ghost of tushima, spider man, fifa 26
claims.evidence: Witness saw a FIFA 22 case; FIFA 26 does not exist as the franchise rebranded to EA Sports FC after FIFA 23.
The warranty seal on the back of the console is not shown.
Thermal performance requires physical testing under load.
The back of the console showing the ports was not included in the report.
No receipt was shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity could be the base 500GB model rather than 1TB.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'Settings > Storage' menu.

risks.risk: The console may have a faulty optical drive or APU (Blue Light of Death).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console booting to the dashboard and launching a disc-based game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be third-party replicas or suffer from analog stick drift.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear labels of the controllers and a video of them navigating the menu.

risks.risk: The console might be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading the FIFA 22 disc.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version and storage capacity.
Photo of the back of the console to inspect the warranty seal and ports.
Photos of the actual game discs for Ghost of Tsushima and Spider-Man.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
response.reason: The witness confirmed the physical presence of the console and controllers, allowing for a baseline valuation at the worst-case functional state. The seller's mention of 'FIFA 26' is a significant red flag regarding their credibility.
